Job Description

About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Financial Services product team. Together, you'll be driving the vision and execution of Mirakl's Financial Services products — from payments to embedded banking — to deliver outstanding value to marketplace operators and sellers worldwide. Your Impact Day-to -day, you will define with the Financial Services team the short and long-term roadmap for features within your scope: Identify new features and evolve existing ones to improve our clients' performance Build and maintain market and product analyses to identify functional gaps and investments to be made Manage, prioritize and optimize the functional backlog for the development team Collect customer feedback and anticipate their future needs Champion AI-native product practices: use our AI stack (Claude Cowork, Gemini, Dust, n8n) across discovery, spec writing and delivery, and proactively propose process improvements to increase the squad's velocity and quality. Collaborate and act as an ambassador with stakeholders: The Engineering Manager and development squad during design workshops Legal and business teams to launch the most viable solutions possible Data Science and Product Design teams to imagine new intelligent features and integrate them into the existing product ecosystem Marketing and Go To Market teams to drive launches, create and contribute to internal and external training and support materials Product and Recruitment teams to participate in recruiting and coaching Product Managers at Mirakl to nurture our Product culture What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in Product Management Proven track record within a SaaS software company Significant experience with financial products and processes: factoring/cash advances, billing and collection mechanisms, payment systems, lending platforms, and embedded banking integrations Hands-on familiarity with API design and integration ecosystems Bonus: experience in a marketplace environment Skills: Product roadmap ownership & backlog prioritization Financial product expertise (payments, lending, embedded banking) Data-driven decision-making Stakeholder communication & cross-functional collaboration Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban) Tech Stack Product Management : ProductBoard, Heap Analytics, Jira, Figma, Hotjar, Zendesk, Slack, Google Suite AI : Claude Cowork, Google Gemini, Dust, n8n Languages French: Full professional proficiency English: Full professional proficiency Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. A 30-minute phone call with one of our Tech Recruiters to discuss your background, your expectations, and discover more about Mirakl A 45-minute Google Meet meeting with the Hiring Manager to dive into the concrete aspects of your expertise and explore how your skills integrate into our projects Two 45-minute Google Meet meetings with the Engineering Manager and future colleagues to discuss our values and company culture We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning.
